description:
Triage an alert (requires manage access: database owner or org admin).

- ``resolve``: the underlying problem is handled or gone.
- ``acknowledge``: keep it standing with a ``statement`` of what is
  happening — only for a situation that may worsen.
- ``dismiss``: false positive / expected; refused while the check still
  trips (it would just respawn).
- ``snooze``: silence for ``hours`` with a ``statement``; reopens by itself
  if the check still trips afterwards.
- ``reopen``: send a parked alert back to "needs action" with a
  ``statement`` of what is no longer covered.

action.description: Transition to apply to the alert
action.title: Action

hours.description: Snooze window in hours (1-168). Required for snooze.
hours.title: Hours

note.description: Optional note appended to the alert details (resolve, dismiss)
note.title: Note

statement.description: One SHORT present-tense plain-text sentence (~120 chars, no Markdown) shown as the alert headline. Required for acknowledge, snooze and reopen.
statement.title: Statement

name: myriade_triage_alert
